literal_meaning: চোখ তুলে দেখা বা চাওয়া (eyes raised to look or desire)
figurative_meaning_en: Fortune becoming favorable or smiling upon someone
similar_in_english: The gods are smiling on you
example_sentences_in_bangla: এতদিন পর তার ভাগ্য চোখ তুলে চাইছে।
আজকের সাফল্য দেখে মনে হচ্ছে ভগবান চোখ তুলে চেয়েছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: After so many years, fortune is finally smiling upon him.
This success makes it seem like God has cast a favorable glance.
history: This idiom draws from the cultural belief in divine intervention, where God or fate 'looks down' favorably, common in Bengali folklore and oral traditions.
note: Often used to express sudden positive change after hardship, invoking a sense of divine benevolence.
